correctness.rationale: The original RESULT.md wrongly inferred computable and c.e. grounded membership merely from ordinary partial-computable predecessor/successor functions: such a function cannot decide undefinedness. Indeed, create x_e and y_{e,s}, with edge y_{e,s}→x_e iff machine e first halts at stage s. The relation is decidable and both neighbor maps are partial computable. Every component is an isolated vertex or one edge, so closure stage=1, but x_e∈G1 iff machine e never halts; hence G1 has noncomputable degree 0′. This definitively refutes the uncorrected claim. The complete corrected RESULT.md supplied here strengthens the hypothesis to total computable optional neighbor maps P,S:A→A∪{⊥}. With this explicit terminating source test, the component parity induction gives the exact stage classification; for finite t, membership is decided by at most 2t predecessor links; in general membership is c.e. The original W* construction has total decidable stage approximations on each edge and therefore total optional-neighbor functions; all a_{e,n} grounded exactly when e∈W*, providing any c.e. degree at ω. Full revised scientific bytes are staged for RESULT, REVIEW, VERIFICATION and METADATA, but publication is not ready until unchanged public AUDIT metadata is sanitized. C PASS applies ONLY to the corrected final claim, not to the original false effective hypothesis.
